players.product: Supercapacitor cells (lead and snap-in type), modules and systems for AI data-center (AIDC) UPS and peak-power control

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (amended annual report, consolidated): revenue KRW 82,228,905 thousand (FY2024 KRW 59,591,710 thousand); operating profit KRW 1,773,718 thousand (FY2024 operating loss KRW 8,067,980 thousand). Management (MD&A): revenue rose about 37.9% to KRW 822 hundred million and operating profit of KRW 17.7 hundred million turned around the prior year's operating loss (about KRW 81 hundred million); the main drivers were higher orders for its main product, supercapacitors, on growing AI data center (AIDC) market demand, wider sales of high-value products and a better cost structure from production efficiency.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue KRW 82,228,905 thousand; operating profit KRW 1,773,718 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Management view (annual report, business overview): AI data centers (AIDC) and the opening smart grid market are at the center of the market shift - as UPS and peak-power control become critical to handle the power use and heat of large-scale computing, demand for high-efficiency supercapacitors is rising explosively; Vina Tech says that from this year it is expanding from single 'cell' supply to 'system'-level supply, and it is investing in its Vietnam subsidiaries to expand production capacity.

FY2025 revenue by product (KRW million): supercapacitor Lead Type 48,145 (smart meters, SSDs, automotive electronics), Snap In Type 22,566 (higher-capacity cells mainly for ESS and auxiliary power), fuel-cell MEA 6,349, catalyst supports 451, deodorizing filters 1,085, other 3,635; by segment, energy storage devices KRW 72,717,404 thousand and fuel cells KRW 9,511,501 thousand; exports were 88.65% of 2025 sales, mostly priced in US dollars.
quarterly_data.figure: Lead Type KRW 48,145 million; Snap In Type KRW 22,566 million; export share 88.65%

quarterly_data.signal: Production (FY2025, KPCS): supercapacitor Lead Type capacity 295,734, output 147,146, utilization 49.76% (2024: 51.03%); Snap In Type capacity 11,085, output 4,864, utilization 43.88% (2024: 18.59%); fuel-cell MEA capacity 300,000 sheets, output 71,633, utilization 23.88% (2024: 32.36%).

Customer concentration (FY2025, customers not named): Customer A KRW 12,462,058 thousand, 15.2% of revenue (prior year 1.8%); Customer B KRW 10,057,786 thousand, 12.2% (prior year 2.0%); the seven largest customers together KRW 47,284,842 thousand, 57.54% (prior year 37.78%).
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A 15.2%; Customer B 12.2%; top seven 57.54%

quarterly_data.signal: Raw materials (FY2025): purchases of activated carbon, electrolyte and similar materials were KRW 40,214,277 thousand, 88.66% of purchases (imports KRW 34,590,796 thousand, 76.26%); the company names exchange rates and mineral resource prices as the factors behind raw-material price changes.
